ModuleMetaData.DescriptionHeadline: MyGUI 3.5.4 render system for OpenGL ES 3 and WebGL 2
ModuleMetaData.DescriptionDetails: The OpenGL ES 3 platform of MyGUI: render manager with GLSL ES 300 shaders (MyGUI_OpenGLES_VP.glsl and MyGUI_OpenGLES_FP.glsl, read through the data manager), textures, render targets and vertex arrays. The image loader is an interface the user of the module implements. Its data manager (a disk based one) is not used by GUCEF, the GUI driver provides one over the virtual file system.
